title: Local AI masks and read-only mask previews for assistants
notes: AI-assisted implementation: generate subject, foreground and sky sub-masks using the app's existing local models, optionally guide subject selection with a point or box, inspect a grayscale matte without changing history, convert cropped-view fractions to mask pixels, upsert multiple masks in one undo step and measure labelled regions from one shared render. Existing GUI model downloads and local inference are reused; no new service. Generation preserves siblings and refuses to commit if the source edit changes. Detailed GUI history labels are tracked separately in #377.
